answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 10796 Country: India Title: As Salaamu Alaikum Wa Rahmatullahi Wa Barkatuh.After my graduation i got selected for a PG Programme whose course fee was more than a lakh rupees.My father was i think not in a position to pay the entire amount at a time so he made me apply for an educational loan.Alhamdulillah I completed my PG and am currently working also but i am worried :Is my salary 100% halal.I could not say him no for a loan at that time coz he is very much in favour of loans,also the seat so obtained was after lot of effort, passing lot of examinations.If it is not 100%halal how to make my earnings fully halal.Now i am supposed to repay the loan in Instalments,can i make instalments in small amounts so that i can save some money every month rather than paying lump sums.I m quite confused and worried.Please advise me.Jazakallahu Khaira. Question: As Salaamu Alaikum Wa Rahmatullahi Wa Barkatuh.After my graduation i got selected for a PG Programme whose course fee was more than a lakh rupees.My father was i think not in a position to pay the entire amount at a time so he made me apply for an educational loan.Alhamdulillah I completed my PG and am currently working also but i am worried :Is my salary 100% halal.I could not say him no for a loan at that time coz he is very much in favour of loans,also the seat so obtained was after lot of effort, passing lot of examinations.If it is not 100%halal how to make my earnings fully halal.Now i am supposed to repay the loan in Instalments,can i make instalments in small amounts so that i can save some money every month rather than paying lump sums.I m quite confused and worried.Please advise me.Jazakallahu Khaira. Answer ID: 10796 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 249/191=H/1429) When you do not commit any haram or makrooh act in the tasks assigned to you, your salary is 100% halal. As far as the interest based loan taken by father is concerned, you should repay it back without delay as soon as possible. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
